scientific_integrity: The infinite statements follow from a block-decomposition proof and integer inequalities. Exact finite enumeration serves as a check, not a proof of generality. Literature comparison is not independent historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Sharp seven- and ten-vertex order thresholds concern unweighted simple connected cactus graphs. Positive weights are permitted only in the general factorization and real-rootedness discriminant criterion. No result is claimed for arbitrary graphs.
title: Sharp seven- and ten-vertex shape thresholds for random cactus spanning-tree leaf counts
